mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verification (email, purpose, code, expires_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{purpose}, #{code}, NOW() + make_interval(mins => #{ttlMinutes}))
mapper.select: SELECT id, customer_id, manager_id, email, purpose, code, expires_at, verified_at, created_at, (expires_at <= NOW()) AS expired FROM email_verification WHERE email = #{email} AND purpose = #{purpose} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verification SET verified_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND verified_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verification (customer_id, purpose, code, expires_at) VALUES (#{customerId}, 'PASSWORD_RESET', #{code}, NOW() + make_interval(mins => #{ttlMinutes}))
mapper.select: SELECT id, customer_id, manager_id, email, purpose, code, expires_at, verified_at, created_at, (expires_at <= NOW()) AS expired FROM email_verification WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND purpose = 'PASSWORD_RESET' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_verification WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND purpose = 'PASSWORD_RESET' AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_at > NOW() - make_interval(mins => #{validMinutes})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verification (manager_id, purpose, code, expires_at) VALUES (#{managerId}, 'PASSWORD_RESET', #{code}, NOW() + make_interval(mins => #{ttlMinutes}))
mapper.select: SELECT id, customer_id, manager_id, email, purpose, code, expires_at, verified_at, created_at, (expires_at <= NOW()) AS expired FROM email_verification WHERE manager_id = #{managerId} AND purpose = 'PASSWORD_RESET' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_verification WHERE manager_id = #{managerId} AND purpose = 'PASSWORD_RESET' AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_at > NOW() - make_interval(mins => #{validMinutes})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_verification WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND purpose = 'PASSWORD_RESET' AND created_at > NOW() - make_interval(secs => #{cooldownSeconds})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_verification WHERE manager_id = #{managerId} AND purpose = 'PASSWORD_RESET' AND created_at > NOW() - make_interval(secs => #{cooldownSeconds})
